name: Pepper Mosaic Virus
scientificName: Pepper mottle virus (PepMoV) / Cucumber mosaic virus (CMV)
description: A viral disease causing mosaic patterns, leaf distortion, and fruit deformation in pepper. Several viruses can cause mosaic symptoms in pepper, transmitted by aphids and through mechanical means.
symptoms: Light and dark green mosaic pattern on leaves
Leaf distortion, puckering, and reduced size
Fruits showing mottling, discoloration, and deformation
causes: Pepper mottle virus, Cucumber mosaic virus, and other potyviruses
Transmitted by aphid vectors in non-persistent manner
Infected seedlings and nearby infected crops
treatments: No curative treatment for viral infections
Control aphid vectors with neem oil or insecticidal soap
Use reflective mulches to repel aphids
prevention: Control weeds that serve as virus reservoirs
Use floating row covers in nurseries to exclude aphids
